recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a woman with voluminous dark hair, wearing a white V-neck top, set against a warm, glowing amber-to-yellow gradient background with a soft-focus spotlight effect at the base. The composition is framed by a thin, multi-colored border and features dynamic script lettering in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm amber background glow complements the subject's skin tone.
The white garment acts as a high-contrast visual anchor against the saturated background.
The diagonal script in the top-left balances the secondary text in the bottom-right.
The soft-focus spotlight at the bottom creates a sense of depth and stage-like presence.
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting on the subject
High-volume, textured hair as a silhouette feature
Diagonal typographic orientation for the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium shot, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white V-neck of the shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script in the top left, moves down to the subject's face, follows the white shirt down to the hands, and finishes at the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample warm-toned negative space around the head and shoulders to emphasize the hair volume.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Amber and golden yellow (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue and burgundy (outer border frames)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value (brightness) in the central subject area.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool greens or harsh grays

letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Hand-drawn cursive with varying line weights, featuring long, expressive ascenders and descenders.
Secondary text: Slanted, bold sans-serif with tight tracking and a drop shadow.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'I' and 'C' in the primary text are oversized and fluid.
A long horizontal underline stroke extends from the tail of the primary script.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between expressive, organic script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn 80s energy of the primary text.
Provides the necessary weight and slant for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s-style curly hair, wearing a white V-neck shirt. Use warm amber lighting with a soft-focus yellow gradient background. Include a bright white spotlight effect at the bottom of the frame where her hands rest. Frame the entire image with a thin border of blue and burgundy.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, hand-drawn cursive script diagonally in the top-left corner. Add a smaller, bold, italicized sans-serif title in the bottom-right corner with a subtle black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and diffused?
Is the primary text oriented diagonally?
Is the hair volume a prominent feature of the silhouette?
Does the bottom text have a visible drop shadow?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the amber background gradient
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white shirt is the brightest element on the subject.
Verify the script text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the border colors are distinct but thin.
Confirm the bottom-right text is legible against the yellow glow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Voluminous Hair + White Clothing + Amber Gradient + Diagonal Script Overlay + Italicized Subtitle
